_comment: Example config.json for engineering-progress-producer. Copy to config.json next to SKILL.md and replace the placeholders. Don't commit a real config.json. The jira_progress namespace and jira-named keys apply to any tracker.

jira_progress.tracker: <jira | github | linear | azure_devops | shortcut | other | pasted>
board_urls: <board, project, or repo URL, for example https://<your-jira-site>/jira/software/c/projects/<PROJ>/boards/<board-id> or https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>>

boards_resolved.cloudId: <site id (cloudId) on Jira, workspace id or null elsewhere; resolved on first run>
boards_resolved.board_filter: <scope query in the tracker's syntax: JQL, GitHub search qualifiers, a saved filter>

custom_fields.flagged: <field id, label, or state that marks blocked; discovered at setup>

support_trends._comment: Optional. Written by support-trends-producer; read-only here. = the support producer's eng_waiting entries with queued_for_jira: true and no linked_jira.
